gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Immich needs at least 6 GB of RAM to run its machine-learning features such as face recognition and smart search (it can run on 4 GB only with machine learning turned off), while the Synology DS225+ and DS425+ it recommended ship with 2 GB and reach only 6 GB with Synology's one 4 GB add-on module.
standout_why: I checked against the cited and top rival pages. homelabcompass.com (Immich vs Synology Photos) says only that 'Performance depends on the NAS CPU and RAM, since the machine learning features want some headroom.' esp32.co.uk covers iOS background limits and says Immich ML acceleration is 'experimental' but gives no RAM floor. itechguides.com says only 'Docker-based deployment requires a supported server environment.' The immich.app/features, partner-sharing, GitHub README and mobile-backup pages ChatGPT cited are feature lists. Synology's own pages give RAM only for Synology Photos object recognition, which ChatGPT already quoted. None gives Immich's 6 GB minimum or compares it with the RAM each recommended NAS ships with. Our current page also lists 'Immich in Container Manager' for the 4 GB DS925+ without this caveat.
decides: It doesn't change the Synology Photos pick, but it does decide the hardware for the Immich route. As shipped, the DS225+ and DS425+ (2 GB), DS925+ (4 GB), Asustor AS5402T (4 GB) and UGREEN DH2300 (4 GB, no Docker) are all below Immich's 6 GB minimum for face and smart search. The DS225+ and DS425+ reach exactly 6 GB only by adding Synology's D4NS01-4G module; Synology says non-Synology RAM limits warranty and support. The QNAP TS-264-8G (8 GB) meets Immich's recommended 8 GB out of the box, and so does the UGREEN DXP2800 if its 8 GB is confirmed. That supports ChatGPT's 'UGREEN for Immich' split and gives the reason ChatGPT never stated. Our page should drop or qualify 'Immich in Container Manager' on the DS925+ and add the RAM floor as a column or note.

findings.label: Immich RAM requirement
findings.value: Minimum 6 GB, recommended 8 GB; 4 GB works only with machine learning disabled
findings.note: Immich's official install requirements. Same page: minimum 2 CPU cores, recommended 4.

findings.label: Immich CPU architecture requirement
findings.value: Runs on amd64 or arm64; the ML container on amd64 needs x86-64-v2 or newer; v2.7.5 was the last x86-64-v1 release and is no longer supported
findings.note: Every x86 NAS here (J4125, N5095, N5105, N100, V1500B) is a 2019-or-later Intel/AMD chip with SSE4.2, which x86-64-v2 needs. That is my inference: no source on this page lists each chip.

findings.label: Immich database storage requirement
findings.value: Database 'should ideally use local SSD storage, and never a network share of any kind'; Postgres needs at least 2 GB RAM under Docker limits; thumbnails and transcodes add 10-20% to library size
findings.note: Sizing note: thumbnails and transcodes add 10-20%, so a 2 TB library needs roughly 2.2-2.4 TB.

findings.label: Immich ML hardware acceleration backends
findings.value: ARM NN (Mali GPUs only), CUDA, ROCm, OpenVINO (Intel GPUs 'such as Iris Xe and Arc'), RKNN (Rockchip RK3566/RK3568/RK3576/RK3588 only, host needs RKNPU driver v0.9.8+); Linux or WSL2 only
findings.note: The page also says 'Integrated GPUs are more likely to experience issues than discrete GPUs', especially older processors and low-RAM servers, and OpenVINO uses more RAM than CPU processing.

findings.label: RAM installed / maximum
findings.value: 2 GB DDR4 non-ECC installed; max 6 GB (2 GB + 4 GB), 1 slot; Intel Celeron J4125
findings.note: Synology lists the D4NS01-4G expansion module and says it won't provide full warranty or tech support if non-Synology modules are used. 2 GB is below Immich's 4 GB no-ML floor. Maxed at 6 GB it just meets Immich's ML minimum.

findings.label: RAM installed / maximum
findings.value: 2 GB DDR4 non-ECC installed; max 6 GB (2 GB + 4 GB), 1 slot; Intel Celeron J4125
findings.note: Same memory limits and the same D4NS01-4G module as the DS225+.

findings.label: RAM installed / maximum

findings.note: As shipped, below Immich's 6 GB ML minimum. Needs a RAM upgrade before Immich face or smart search is supported.

findings.label: RAM installed / maximum
findings.value: 8 GB SODIMM DDR4 installed (since 2024/01); max 16 GB (2 x 8 GB); Intel Celeron N5095
findings.note: Meets Immich's recommended 8 GB out of the box.
